name: cache-keep
description: Cache Keep: keeps an idle conversation's one-hour prompt cache alive, then compacts it if it stays idle.

enabled.title: Cache Keep
enabled.description: Keep an idle conversation's prompt cache alive and compact it after the last ping.

pingMinutes.title: Cache Keep: minutes between pings
pingMinutes.description: How long the conversation stays idle before each ping. Keep it under 60, the cache's lifetime.

pings.title: Cache Keep: pings before compacting
pings.description: How many pings an idle conversation gets before Cache Keep decides whether to compact it.

compactBelowPercent.title: Cache Keep: compact below percent
compactBelowPercent.description: Compact only when the size right after the last compaction is below this percent of the current size. Otherwise send one more ping and stop.
